jobs.title: Customer Sales Associate, SM City Bacoor
jobs.description: We are looking for a Customer Sales Associate to provide attentive, knowledgeable, and personalized customer service. This position will be reporting to work at SM City Bacoor . You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Customer Engagement and Service Delivery Welcome and acknowledge customers in a warm, respectful, and professional manner. Observe customer behaviour and offer assistance at an appropriate time without creating unnecessary pressure Understand customer needs through relevant questions and active listening. Assist customers in identifying suitable products based on preferences, occasion, size, and availability. Maintain a helpful and respectful approach throughout the customer journey. Handle routine customer inquiries and refer concerns requiring authorization to the Store Head. Product Knowledge and Merchandise Assistance Maintain working knowledge of current collections, product categories, sizes, styles, features, and available merchandise. Explain product information accurately and avoid unsupported claims. Recommend appropriate complementary products when relevant to customer needs. Assist with product selection, fitting-room requirements, alternative sizes, and styling options. Maintain appropriate customer privacy, comfort, and professional boundaries. Sales Productivity Contribute to the achievements of store sales targets through effective customer assistance. Apply customer engagement techniques that support conversion, ATV, UPT, and other approved KPIs. Participate in daily sales briefings and understand assigned productivity objectives. Respond constructively to coaching and implement agreed improvements. Balance sales productivity with the brand’s non-hard-selling service philosophy. Selling-Floor and Merchandise Standards Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and presentation of assigned selling areas. Replenish merchandise and maintain correct product placements, size arrangement, and display standards. Ensure

jobs.title: Cashier, SM Bacolod
jobs.description: We are looking for a Cashier to serve as an important control point in the completion of each customer purchase. This position will be reporting to work at SM Bacolod. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Transaction Processing and Accuracy Process customer purchases accurately using POS system. Verify merchandise description, quantity, price, discounts, and transaction totals. Confirm that scanned merchandise corresponds to the actual items purchased. Apply only approved promotions, discounts, and transaction adjustments. Issue the required invoice or other approved transaction documents in accordance with company procedures and regulations. Immediately report pricing discrepancies, POS errors, and transaction irregularities. Payment Handling and Security Accept and process only company-approved payment methods. Follow prescribed procedures for cash, card, electronic wallet, and other authorized payment transactions. Verify payment completion before releasing merchandise. Safeguard cash, payment records, and assigned cashiering equipment. Prevent unauthorized access to POS accounts, cash drawers, and transaction records. Report suspected fraudulent transactions or payment irregularities. Customer Checkout Experience Greet and acknowledge customers courteously at the checkout counter. Process transactions with accuracy and reasonable efficiency. Explain payment, exchange, and other relevant policies clearly and respectfully. Address routine checkout inquiries and refer disputed matters to the Store Head. Thank customers sincerely and conclude transactions with the brand's customer service standards. Merchandise Verification and Packing Verify that all merchandise presented for payment has been correctly recorded in the transaction. Check merchandise condition and confirm that the correct items and quantities are released. Remove security tags or other applicable security devices following approved procedures. jobs.title: E commerce Account Specialist
jobs.description: Summary We are looking for an E-commerce Account Specialist to manage and monitor our online presence across various e-commerce platforms, including Shopee, Lazada, Zalora, and Shopify. Your responsibilities will extend to coordinating closely with the Marketing and Merchandising Planning and Control Department to ensure alignment between online sales strategies and overall business objectives. This is an onsite position at Armal Compound 2, M. Eusebio Avenue, San Miguel, Pasig City. Roles and responsibilities Manage and maintain e-commerce platforms to showcase latest trends and collections, optimizing product titles, descriptions, and imagery. Partner with Marketing to align our online sales strategies with the captivating campaigns they craft. Collaborate closely with our Merchandising Planning and Control Department to ensure our online assortments are in sync with our offline offerings, creating a seamless shopping experience for our customers. Analyze performance data to uncover actionable insights that refine promotional calendars and product assortment. Resolve customer inquiries with empathy and efficiency to create memorable and meaningful experiences and build brand loyalty for Fashion Fusion Bring collaborative spirit, working closely with cross-functional teams like Store Operations, Fulfillment, and Customer Service to ensure our online operations run smoothly. Share your knowledge and insights with your teammates, fostering a culture of continuous leaming and growth. Perform other related duties and functions as assigned by the company.

jobs.title: Human Resources Intern
jobs.description: The Organization & Employee Development Intern will support the HR team in employee engagement activities, training and development, and organization development. The role involves assisting with planning, coordination, documentation, and program support while gaining practical experience in HR operations and communication. Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. Event Proposal Development: Help conceptualize and prepare employee engagement event proposals, conduct research, collaborate with stakeholders, create multimedia materials for internal communications, and develop a comprehensive event proposal from planning through execution.

jobs.title: Real Estate Business Developer
jobs.description: Decathlon Philippines is committed to a strategic, multi-year expansion initiative to better serve our customers across the region! To accompany this fast development, we are looking for a Real Estate Business Developer to develop, execute and manage business development projects leading to a profitable and sustainable growth for Decathlon within a dedicated zone/region. Key Responsibilities 1. Develop Local Expansion Strategy Define the vision and strategy for Decathlon's development (including stores and other formats) within the territory to increase market share. This includes: Analyzing market data (traffic, sales performance, competition, etc.). Designing the multi-channel network and planning the implementation of new solutions (e.g., shops, lockers, digital points), ensuring alignment with the Country Project. 2. Lead Project Development & Execution Manage the full lifecycle of real estate projects, including new openings and relocations: Source, negotiate, and secure sites (purchases/leases). Execute projects: Prepare studies, validate technical/financial details, secure permits, coordinate legal aspects, and control the budget. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Manage Real Estate Portfolio Oversee the optimization and performance of the existing real estate assets: Track the financial performance (revenue/costs vs. budget) during a project's first year. Identify and execute store optimization opportunities (e.g., downsizing, enlarging, efficiency improvements, or green building investments). Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines. jobs.title: Junior AI Video Editor
jobs.description: We're looking for a new graduate who's been making videos and exploring AI image and video tools. Maybe you've shot short films, edited content for TikTok or YouTube, played with Runway, Kling, or ElevenLabs, or made AI-generated images for fun. You'll spend your days creating images and videos, building workflows with the latest AI tools, and helping shape new AI-powered products and apps. This is a discovery-oriented role: you'll be one of the first hires defining how we use AI to make compelling creative work at scale. Job responsibilities: Edit and produce video content. Create compelling short-form videos, motion content, and visual assets — combining traditional editing craft with AI generation tools to deliver work that meets creative standards across digital, social, and product channels. Create AI-generated images and visuals. Produce stills and motion content using AI image and video generation platforms. Develop the visual instincts to push past default AI outputs and toward intentional, on-brief work. Build and document AI creative workflows. Design end-to-end production pipelines using AI tools like Kling (video), Nano Banana (image), and ElevenLabs (voice). Streamline workflows, optimize output quality, and document what works so the team can replicate and scale. Support AI-driven product development. Collaborate with R&D and IT on AI-powered products and features built for external/market-facing use. Translate creative concepts into proof-of-concept assets that inform product direction. Develop prompt engineering and tool fluency. Build expertise in prompting, model selection, and parameter tuning across image, video, and voice tools. Maintain a working library of prompts, references, and visual style guides. Learn and explore AI continuously. Track emerging AI models, techniques, and platforms. Run small experiments to test new tools, push toward more compelling outputs, and share findings with the team — your curiosity directly shapes our creative c

jobs.title: Supply Planning Analyst
jobs.description: In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Collect and consolidate data from both internal and external sources, coordinating with relevant stakeholders to obtain necessary inputs for report generation. Conceptualizes and develop business reporting tools for Supply Chain and S&OP strategies (usage of complex formula, macro). Conduct regular reviews of item forecasts, safety stock levels, ABC and SLD code classifications, and stocking indicators to ensure accuracy and alignment with business requirements. Gather and analyze stakeholder requirements, providing actionable recommendations and driving continuous improvement initiatives based on customer needs. Collaborate cross-functionally with departments such as Product Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Customer Service to obtain critical commercial data (e.g., MOQ, ADU, Inventory Code Classifications). Maintain and monitor business systems and applications by validating data accuracy, tracking changes, and ensuring overall data integrity. Who You Are: You have a strong drive for results and exhibit passion and enthusiasm to get things done. You can efficiently carry out tasks independently and generate accurate, high-quality reports. You are proactive and highly innovative in approaching problem-solving efficiently. You can proficiently communicate ideas and influence both internal and external customers. You build collaborative relationships across teams and work effectively with people at any level. Our Culture & Commitment to You: At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description: In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Partner with Product Management and key stakeholders to understand product vision, customer needs, business objectives, and roadmap priorities, translating them into actionable direction for development teams. Support Program Increment (PI) planning activities by refining features and user stories, identifying dependencies and risks, and contributing to meaningful business outcomes. Manage and continuously refine the team backlog to balance customer value, business priorities, technical requirements, quality improvements, and team capacity. Develop clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting requirements that enable effective and efficient software delivery. Help teams understand the customer impact and business value behind planned functionality, enabling informed prioritization and decision-making. Gather and incorporate customer and stakeholder feedback to enhance usability, reliability, and overall product experience. Collaborate across development, quality, architecture, operations, and security teams to coordinate work, address dependencies, and support successful delivery outcomes. Review completed work against defined acceptance criteria and intended business results, leveraging feedback and lessons learned to improve future planning. Communicate effectively with global stakeholders, providing clarity on priorities, progress, risks, and key decisions. Contribute to the ongoing improvement of Agile practices, team collaboration, and delivery effectiveness.
